{"code": "import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Use only base Python and numpy
# Compute contingency table manually
treatment_responded = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].sum()
treatment_not_responded = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0] - treatment_responded
control_responded = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].sum()
control_not_responded = df[df['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0] - control_responded

# Contingency table
table = np.array([[treatment_responded, treatment_not_responded],
                   [control_responded, control_not_responded]])
print(table)

# Chi-squared test using manual calculation (for p-value)
# Expected frequencies
row_sums = table.sum(axis=1)
col_sums = table.sum(axis=0)
total = table.sum()
expected = np.outer(row_sums, col_sums) / total

# Chi-squared statistic
chi2 = np.sum((table - expected)**2 / expected)

# Degrees of freedom
df = (table.shape[0] - 1) * (table.shape[1] - 1)

# P-value using chi2 distribution (approximate)
from scipy.stats import chi2
p_value = 1 - chi2.cdf(chi2, df)

print(f"Chi-squared statistic: {chi2}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")

# Check balance: age, sex, severity, site, assay_batch
balance_check = {}
for col in ['age', 'sex', 'severity', 'site', 'assay_batch']:
    if df[col].dtype == 'object':
        # Categorical: use chi-squared
        tab = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df[col])
        # Expected frequencies
        row_sums = tab.sum(axis=1)
        col_sums = tab.sum(axis=0)
        total = tab.sum()
        expected = np.outer(row_sums, col_sums) / total
        chi2 = np.sum((tab - expected)**2 / expected)
        df = (tab.shape[0] - 1) * (tab.shape[1] - 1)
        p_val = 1 - chi2.cdf(chi2, df)
        balance_check[col] = p_val
    else:
        # Continuous: use t-test
        t1 = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment'][col]
        t2 = df[df['arm'] == 'control'][col]
        n1, n2 = len(t1), len(t2)
        mean1, mean2 = t1.mean(), t2.mean()
        var1, var2 = t1.var(), t2.var()
        pooled_var = ((n1-1)*var1 + (n2-1)*var2) / (n1 + n2 - 2)
        se = np.sqrt(pooled_var * (1/n1 + 1/n2))
        t_stat = (mean1 - mean2) / se
        # Approximate p-value using t-distribution
        # Use degrees of freedom
        df = n1 + n2 - 2
        # Use scipy's t.cdf for p-value
        from scipy.stats import t
        p_val = 2 * (1 - t.cdf(abs(t_stat), df))
        balance_check[col] = p_val

balance_check"}
